title: hebe coxiana
intro: Hebe coxiana, commonly known as the Cox's Hebe or Hebe 'Mrs. Cox', is a species of flowering plant in the hebe genus, native to New Zealand. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it useful in treating anxiety and stress-related conditions. The health benefits of Hebe coxiana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative and anti-anxiety effects.
